title: From LLM Inference to Agentic Workloads: Characterization and Implications for Serving Systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.15127v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agentic applications are shifting AI serving from isolated model inference to long-running workloads in which LLMs coordinate tools, environments, and persistent state. However, the system behavior of these workloads---where latency, cost, and bottlenecks arise---remains poorly characterized, leaving serving systems to rely on assumptions built for conventional inference. We present AgentSysBench, a benchmark suite and measurement toolkit with ten representative agentic applications and unified systems-level instrumentation. translated_title: 从LLM推理到代理工作负载：特征及其对服务系统的影响
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15127v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：代理应用程序正在将AI服务从孤立的模型推理转变为长时间运行的工作负载，其中LLM协调工具、环境和持久状态。然而，这些工作负载的系统行为——延迟、成本和瓶颈产生的地方——仍然缺乏清晰的特征描述，导致服务系统依赖于为传统推理构建的假设。我们提出了AgentSysBench，一个基准测试套件和测量工具包，包含十个代表性的代理应用程序和统一的系统级仪器。通过在受控部署和生产轨迹中的实验，我们确定了六个区分代理工作负载与传统LLM服务的属性：（1）执行是重量级且有状态的，非LLM组件在10个应用程序中的5个中主导延迟，沙箱工作集内存峰值达到每个会话28 GB；（2）应用程序组合了具有异构资源亲和性的组件——GPU绑定的推理、记忆
tldr: 本文提出了AgentSysBench基准测试套件，系统性地刻画了代理工作负载与传统LLM服务的六大差异，揭示了非LLM组件主导延迟、状态化执行等关键特征，为服务系统设计提供了新依据。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AgentSysBench, a benchmark suite that systematically characterizes six key differences between agentic workloads and conventional LLM serving, revealing that non-LLM components dominate latency and execution is stateful, offering new insights for serving system design.
